findings.observation: The completion checker hashes only roster test modules; it does not bind non-test helpers or its own runner bytes to the record.
findings.recommended_action: Keep the documented independent whole-Git/source identity check and a fresh output directory in the workflow; do not advertise the standalone checker as a complete source-identity check.
findings.reproduction: After a completed isolated run, create or alter a non-test scripts helper and invoke check: it still passes.

findings.observation: The same runner implements run and check. An early SystemExit(0) in the runner itself makes both invocations exit zero without a record. Test-module early zero exits are correctly rejected by the independent invocation.
findings.recommended_action: In a separate workflow operation, require the completion record to exist and validate the checker result/count (or an independently maintained validator); preserve the whole-source check. Returning zero from the two modes alone is insufficient.
findings.reproduction: In an isolated runner copy, insert raise SystemExit(0) immediately after the future import; invoke run then check on a nonexistent output directory.

findings.initial_observation: The initial CLI accepted duplicate numerical flags and silently used the last one; the selected final value was bounded, so this was not an oversized-power bypass.
findings.repair: A unique-option action rejects every repeated numerical option; abbreviated flag names are disabled.

scope: isolated control-runner fault injection and exact-query CLI review; not cryptographic qualification
